 Who we are

 

 

 
 Welcome to The Beach Bun, where the sun is bright, the vibe is easy, and the food hits the spot every single time.We’re a family-owned, family-loved beachside restaurant built around one simple idea: great food makes great memories. Our crew has always believed that the best days are the ones spent together — toes in the sand, stomachs full, and smiles big. So we created a place that feels exactly like that.Here, we keep things fun, fresh, and full of flavor. Our smash burgers sizzle, our hot dogs are legendary, and every bite is meant to taste like summer. Whether you’re rolling in straight from the beach, grabbing a quick bite with the kids, or settling in for an easygoing meal, we’ve got you covered.At The Beach Bun, you’re not just a customer — you’re part of the beach day.And around here, Beach Days Forever isn’t just a slogan. It’s the way we live!
